what: independent re-derivation of every designated-damaged denominator in paperC, with the effect of the hardcoded DAMAGED_OLMO list measured rather than assumed

verbatim: XF_DAMAGED   = {"k8", "k10", "k12", "k14"}  # #250 counts k14 as damaged (no heal)
root_cause.consequence: one hardcoded 3-element list defines BOTH headline denominators (MMLU-Pro 14/15 and off-MMLU 0/15). It omits olmo2/shortgpt16 and olmo2/keep14.

INTERNAL_INCONSISTENCY_FOUND_BY_AGENT.severity: this is the decisive fact for the remedy, and it was NOT in the MAIN adjudication
INTERNAL_INCONSISTENCY_FOUND_BY_AGENT.statement: depth-14 is counted as designated damaged for llama2_7b, llama3_8b and qwen3_8b_base (rung k14) but NOT for olmo2_7b (rung keep14) -- inside the SAME 15-cell denominator (15 = 3 OLMo rungs + 3 families x 4 rungs).
INTERNAL_INCONSISTENCY_FOUND_BY_AGENT.why_it_settles_the_remedy: an exclusion rule based on 'retains too much of the stack' is unavailable, because the identical retained depth IS counted three times over in the same ratio. MAIN's option (b) (named exclusion with a stated rule) therefore has no rule available that is not family-specific, and 04_experiments.tex:23 forbids family-specific designation ('fixed by construction, never by a measured score'). Option (a), full inclusion, is the only internally consistent fix.
INTERNAL_INCONSISTENCY_FOUND_BY_AGENT.propagation: the 0/60 off-MMLU non-OLMo count is 3 families x 4 rungs x 5 benchmarks and therefore contains all three k14 arms.

THIRD_DENOMINATOR_FOUND_BY_AGENT.statement: the paper's own power denominator is 21 ('all 21 evaluated cells are powered'), and 21 minus the 4 intact bases is 17 damaged cells, not 15. shortgpt16 and keep14 are inside the favourable denominator and outside the unfavourable one.

chance_side_recomputed.note: MAIN explicitly did not determine whether the above-CHANCE half changes. It does.

mmlupro_denominator_ladder.note: MAIN's quoted '14/16' is arithmetically correct for restoring shortgpt16 alone. The adopted fix restores both arms and reads 15/17 at or below the floor.

MONOTONE_DEPTH_THRESHOLD.claim: every off-MMLU cell that clears its floor comes from an OLMo-2 arm retaining >=14 of 32 layers; no arm retaining <=12 clears any floor in any family.

separation_pp.note: the two sets do not overlap: the smallest above-floor margin is larger than the largest at-or-below point estimate, so the threshold is not an artefact of borderline cells.

MONOTONE_DEPTH_THRESHOLD.caveat: regime and family are confounded exactly as the paper already states: the only prune-then-heal family is OLMo-2. The threshold is therefore a statement about the OLMo-2 ladder, and the 0/60 truncate-only result is consistent with it only because no truncate-only arm retains more than 14 layers.

mmlupro_is_NOT_monotone_at_depth_14.olmo2_keep14_mmlupro: +0.3241 pp, p=0.3234, AT the floor -- does NOT clear
mmlupro_is_NOT_monotone_at_depth_14.olmo2_keep14_offmmlu: 4 of 5 small benchmarks clear the floor
mmlupro_is_NOT_monotone_at_depth_14.reading: MMLU-Pro is the harder benchmark, so the depth at which the letter read-out recovers is benchmark-dependent. The threshold is depth>=16 on MMLU-Pro and depth>=14 off MMLU-Pro. Reporting it as a single number would be an overclaim.

DEPTH_ALONE_IS_INSUFFICIENT.measured: the three truncate-only families have 15 cells at retained depth 14 and 0 of them clear their floor, while OLMo-2 keep14 (same retained depth) clears 4 of 5.
DEPTH_ALONE_IS_INSUFFICIENT.implication: the threshold is depth>=14 AND prune-then-heal, not depth>=14 alone. Since OLMo-2 is the only healed family, regime and family remain confounded and the threshold must be stated as a property of the OLMo-2 ladder.
DEPTH_ALONE_IS_INSUFFICIENT.why_recorded: an earlier draft of the deliverable wrote 'depth<=12 gives 0/35', which was an arithmetic slip (correct: 0/60) and which also obscured that the informative contrast is the 0/15 non-OLMo cells AT depth 14.
